Table 19 Cognito Design 
Attribute Description 
leagueRank Holds the value of the current user’s leader board rank. 
currentLeaderboardId If the user is competing this will hold Id of the current 
leader board, they are competing on. 
seenWelcome A boolean value to determine whether the user has seen 
the welcome message for leader boards. 
rankChanged A boolean value, set to true if the user is demoted or 
promoted at the end of the week. Allowing the UI to tell 
the user of their new status.
